packageRules.description: Weaver bumps also need the release's checksums in versions.env
prBodyNotes: Run `tools/install_weaver.sh --print-checksums` and paste its output over the `WEAVER_SHA256_*` lines in `versions.env`; CI fails the checksum until then.

packageRules.description: A core bump also moves the dependency's schema_url in model/manifest.yaml
prBodyNotes: Update the core dependency's `schema_url` in `model/manifest.yaml` to the new version; `tools/check_weaver_pins.py` fails until then.
